description: Add owned contacts to a contact list (list_id, or list_name as its name or slug). Returns added, already_member and not_found (ids that aren't the owner's contacts); a repeat adds nothing. create_if_missing=true creates a list named list_name first. Family follows relationships and is refused (code AUTO_SYNCED_LIST): set the relationship with update_person. undo_contact_change(change_id) removes the ones added. ($0.05; API key required)

create_if_missing.description: Create the list named list_name if it does not exist (default false).

list_name.description: Contact list name or slug, when list_id is not known.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).
